description: Test file for Kubernetes OpenAPI controller, containing unit tests for adding, removing, and updating CustomResourceDefinitions and their corresponding OpenAPI paths.

classes.name: testEnv
classes.description: Test environment struct containing clientset, HTTP mux, and control functions for testing OpenAPI controller.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment with fake clientset, informer factory, HTTP server, and controller run/cleanup functions.

methods.name: pollForCondition
methods.description: Polls until a specified condition on the OpenAPI Swagger object is true.

methods.name: pollForPathExists
methods.description: Polls until a specific API path exists in the OpenAPI Swagger object.

methods.name: pollForPathNotExists
methods.description: Polls until a specific API path does not exist in the OpenAPI Swagger object.

methods.name: fetchOpenAPIOrDie
methods.description: Fetches the OpenAPI Swagger JSON from the test HTTP server and unmarshals it.

methods.name: expectPath
methods.description: Asserts that a specific path exists in the OpenAPI Swagger object.

methods.name: expectNoPath
methods.description: Asserts that a specific path does not exist in the OpenAPI Swagger object.
